**Short answer:** 30W is the minimum, and 70W or higher gets you fast charging.

**What Apple says** ([Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/en-us/109509)):
- Any USB-C charger that supports USB Power Delivery (USB PD) will charge a USB-C MacBook Air. For best results, it should provide at least the wattage of the adapter Apple recommends for your model.
- For 2022-and-later MacBook Airs, Apple lists 30W (13-inch only), 35W dual-port, 67W and 70W adapters.
- Apple's [M4 13-inch specs](https://fd.xuwubk.eu.org/https/support.apple.com/en-us/122209) say it ships with a 30W adapter (8-core GPU) or a 35W dual-port adapter (10-core GPU). Fast charging needs a 70W adapter.
- Apple's [M5 specs](https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/specs/?subId1=UUtbUdUnU72396YYw&subId2=dtb) list a 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max in the box. Fast charging needs a 70W or higher USB PD source.
- Apple's [spec page](https://images.apple.com/tm/macbook-air/specs/) gives 30W as the minimum wattage to charge the device.
- 2018–2021 models use a 30W or 40W (60W max) adapter with a USB-C cable.

**Which to pick:**
- **Everyday charging:** 30–45W is enough.
- **Fast charging:** get 70W or higher. Apple's fast-charge spec is 70W, so a 65W charger may not qualify.
- **Using the laptop while charging:** more headroom is better, so go with 65–70W.

**One option from the search results:** the [Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W charger](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u) is $49.99 for a 2-pack (list $59.99, price verified 2026-10-21 on the Baseus US store). It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.
- It delivers 65W from either USB-C port when it's the only device connected.
- With two or three devices plugged in, the laptop port drops to 45W. That's still enough for a MacBook Air, just not the fastest speed.
- Its 65W output is below Apple's 70W fast-charge figure.
- That page is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission if you buy through it.

You'll also need a USB-C cable, or the MagSafe 3 cable that comes with your Air. If you tell me your model and year, I can narrow this down.
